question: What destructive power can an angered adept exercise over the triple world?
premises: Anger is the condition for this power.
The entire triple world is the object.
Both moving and unmoving beings are included.
inference: When angered, the adept can destroy the entire triple world with all moving and unmoving beings.
plain_english: When angry, he can destroy the entire triple world, with all that moves and does not move.
